MSU WEATHER SOURCE PACK — retrieved October 12, 2026

This pack contains the public responses from all 14 URLs named in the brief.
It gives an implementation agent real local HTML and a raw-data sample to
build from. These are downloaded responses, not the original server-side
ASP code, database, or a backup of the entire three websites.

CONTENTS
input/mawn: homepage, Benzonia and SWMREC station pages, and Benzonia hourly,
  daily, and maintenance report pages.
input/rawdata: directory listings and the unmodified 3hr/benzonia file.
input/agweather: homepage, current-weather page, forecast-products page.
input/climate: homepage and climate-maps page.
derived/text: convenient text extractions; use original input/ for fidelity.
derived/preformatted: report blocks extracted without whitespace reformatting.
manifest.csv: each downloaded URL, local path, timestamp, status, SHA-256.
link-inventory.csv: link and asset references extracted locally. An inventory
  entry is NOT evidence that its target was downloaded or verified.
receipts: robots.txt files and HTTP request records.

IMPORTANT LIMITS
Only the 14 named source URLs were fetched, once each. There was no recursive
crawl, link following, form submission, or asset retrieval. CSS, JavaScript,
image and climate-map files referenced by the HTML are not included. Raw HTML
is not a self-contained saved webpage; opening it in a browser may make
additional live requests. Inspect it as text, or use a browser with remote
requests blocked. Do not use its appearance as a faithful offline baseline.

Hourly and daily reports have real missing-value markers such as --, --- and
NA. Preserve them; do not replace them with zero or fill in observations.
The raw file has different record widths (10 and 20 columns were observed)
and no column header. Do not guess a schema, field units, timezone, or quality
flags. Use the explicitly labeled report pages first, and get a data dictionary
from the maintainer before interpreting the raw columns.
Downloaded time is not observation time or proof that every source is current.
SWMREC metadata is included; its reports and raw data were not downloaded.
Full station coverage, a complete site inventory, original screenshots, and
before/after accessibility results are not provided by this source pack.

WHAT TO DO
Unzip the pack. Give its input/ directory, manifest.csv and this file to the
agent building the demo, and paste the following instruction:

Use the attached weather-source-pack as the local source input. I am choosing
the files-provided path. Build the modernization demo from input/ and trace
every source to manifest.csv. Inspect derived/preformatted/ for Benzonia's
real reports. Keep missing values intact. Make no additional requests to the
live hosts, including automatic browser asset requests. Label unavailable
images, products, and station data honestly. Treat link-inventory.csv as
discovered references, not fetched pages. Do not run a broad crawler or claim
all-station coverage, WCAG conformance, complete source-code access, or a
production security fix. Continue with the implementation using these files.

For a full production replacement, ask the maintainer for an approved export
of the web root/source, data schema and sample data, and backend dependencies.
Do not request credentials or secret configuration as prototype inputs.
